title: Joey Browner, star defensive back for USC and Vikings, dies at 65

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Joey Browner, star defensive back for USC and Vikings, dies at 65
sources.description: Joey Browner, a defensive back who was named USC's team MVP in 1982, has died at age 65. He was an inductee to the Minnesota Vikings Ring of Honor and named to the NFL 1980s all-decade team.
